title: C10 pools branch into different frameworks.
C10 전구체에서 서로 다른 골격으로.
intro: Follow GPP and the genuine alternative NPP branch. The selected cyclases use class I ionisation chemistry; bornyl diphosphate retains diphosphate. Framework cards describe structural membership, while the peppermint branch shows later tailoring.
GPP와 실제 대체 기질인 NPP의 분기를 따라가세요. 선택한 고리화 효소는 class I 이온화 기전을 사용하며 bornyl diphosphate는 diphosphate를 유지합니다. 골격 카드는 구조 계열을, peppermint 가지는 후속 변형을 보여줍니다.

edges.label: Myrcene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: An acyclic GPP-to-myrcene branch. Required metal ions depend on the characterised enzyme.

edges.label: Linalool synthase · water capture
edges.detail: Stereospecific linalool synthases differ. The linalool card is a stereounassigned connectivity reference, not an R/S assignment.

edges.label: (-)-Limonene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A characterised stereospecific cyclisation to the displayed (-)-(4S)-limonene record.

edges.label: (-)-α-Pinene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: Representative pinane-forming class I cyclisation. The displayed negative stereoisomer must not be assigned to a positive-pinene synthase.

edges.label: (+)-BPS · TPS I · diphosphate retained
edges.detail: GPP ionises, rearranges and cyclises; diphosphate is recaptured. There is no net PPi release in GPP-to-bornyl-diphosphate conversion. Retention is not evidence for TPS II.

edges.label: Tomato PHS1 · major product
edges.detail: Tomato type VI trichome PHS1 uses NPP to produce beta-phellandrene as a major product with additional monoterpenes. The displayed connectivity record leaves its stereocentre unassigned.

edges.label: GES · ionisation / water capture
edges.detail: Geranyl diphosphate diphosphatase forms geraniol with water capture; this is not ring-forming chemistry.

edges.label: Peppermint tailoring · several stages
edges.detail: Multiple hydroxylation, dehydrogenation, reduction and isomerisation steps are condensed. This is not one enzyme reaction.

edges.label: Pulegone reductase · NADPH
edges.detail: The peppermint enzyme forms (-)-menthone and (+)-isomenthone. This map follows one product branch; the enzyme is not exclusive for the displayed product.

edges.label: MMR · major alcohol product
edges.detail: Recombinant peppermint MMR produced 95% (-)-menthol and 5% (+)-neomenthol from (-)-menthone in the cited assay.

edges.label: MNR · different major epimer
edges.detail: Recombinant MNR produced 94% (+)-neomenthol and 6% (-)-menthol. The two enzymes favour different major products; the products are not exclusive.
